historic_survey.note: Listed as Mission Dolores among the properties in the survey area listed in or formally determined eligible for the National Register and the California Register, and as San Francisco Landmark No. 1. The statement gives the landmark's boundaries as covering both the mission of about 1781–1791 and the basilica of about 1918, spanning Assessor Block 3566, Lots 1 and 2; Planning names this lot the Mission San Francisco de Asís Cemetery and the roll classes it a vacant lot. The Department recommends the landmark designation report be amended, in consultation with community members, to cover the American Indian community — particularly the Ramaytush Ohlone — before, during and after the Mission era.
